coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore, hyphen or comb run: the characters' box (first to last character). Text tick box "/ /" or "[ ]": the three characters' box. Drawn rule: its x extent and the 10 pt above it. Drawn box: its rectangle.
how_measured: Picture pages measured in their own pixels (450x741, 96 ppi, 0.75 pt/px; combs, lines and grey boxes found by dark runs at thresholds 215-245), converted through each picture's placement; every page looked at; overlays looked at.

third_parties: internal use box (accepted by, Wells Advisors acceptance, batch, cert, account; page 11)
signing.kind: A two-page REIT subscription agreement filed as two pictures (pages 8 and 11), after six pages of notices and instructions. The primary and secondary investor initial four representations and sign section 5; the custodian signs section 1 for custodial accounts; the broker/dealer and up to three registered representatives complete and sign section 6. The company's acceptance is only inside the "For Internal Use Only" box.
signing.individual_and_entity: not separated (a "legal entity" check box in section 1)

sure_per_page.8: sure of the places; combs split at their thick ticks; the three "__ MPP / Profit Sharing / Keogh" check places and the allocation lines measured by eye at 96 ppi (in doubt by about 1 pt)
sure_per_page.11: sure of the places; whose the special instructions box is, is open (unclear)
